en: Theragāthā 1.3 Ekakanipāta Paṭhamavagga (The First Chapter of the Single Verses)
The Verse of the Elder Kaṅkhārevata:
like a fire blazing in the night;”
"Those who dispel the doubts of those who have come to them become givers of light and givers of vision.
Thus indeed did the venerable elder Kaṅkhārevata speak this verse.
